mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR , TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , t1.TR_CD , t1.FUND_CD , t1.TR_CO_CD , t1.TRUSTEE , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , t1.BS_TYPE , t1.TR_SEQ , t1.CURRENCY , t1.TR_JUSU , t1.TR_DANGA , t1.TR_TAX , t1.TR_COST , t1.TR_AEK , TO_CHAR(t1.GYULJE_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS gyulje_ymd , t1.GYULJE_AEK , F_JM_NM(t1.CORP_GR, t1.JM_CD) AS xx_yj_cd , t1.GYULJE_JM_CD , t1.COUNT_COST , t1.SEC_CODE , t1.SETT_LOCATION , t1.COUNT_BIC , t1.TRANS_RT , t1.WON_GYULJE_AEK , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , ia.FUND_CURRENCY , t1.FCUR_GYULJE_AEK , CASE WHEN t1.TR_YMD >= F_WORKDATE(t1.CORP_GR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS p_visible FROM SYT0MG t1 JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t1.TR_CD = #{trCd} ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC , t1.JM_CD ASC
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd FROM SYT0MG t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_CD IN ( SELECT ta.TR_CD FROM SZX1PT ta WHERE ta.OBJ_ID = 'W_JA035K' ) ORDER BY tr_ymd

SELECT t1.CURRENCY AS currency , F_CURRENCY_RT(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), t1.CURRENCY) AS transRt , ( SELECT ya.JM_CD FROM SYM0YA ya WHERE ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.CURRENCY = t1.CURRENCY AND ya.GYULJE_JM = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS gyuljeJmCd FROM SYX2MM t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TRUSTEE = #{trustee} AND ROWNUM = 1
